title: Flooding forces hundreds to flee homeless shelter in San Diego
summary: Officials evacuated about 325 men and women from Bridge shelter on New Year’s Day after heavy rains For the third time in seven years, hundreds of people had to flee a homeless shelter in downtown San Diego this week after a heavy storm dropped a month’s worth of rain, causing floods. The area received 2in of rain on New Year’s Day, which broke local records and forced multiple water rescues, according to the San Diego Union-Tribune . Continue reading...
